obligations.note: POST /payees/{id}/reopen is bound to privileged action manage_payees with mfa=False, while the close route for the same action requires MFA. The exhaustive control test failed on that route, and EXC-0183 cannot excuse it: it expired on 2026-09-13, before review on 2026-10-16, and its scope is only the reconciliation batch account, not every caller of the route.

reopen_payee updates only status and closed_at. NPI columns are still written through the vault seal path, and tests/controls/test_encryption_control.py::test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed on the head commit.

LedgerService.reopen_payee records an audit event with actor, action reopen_payee, target payee id, and the service clock time after the store update. The other state-changing methods in service.py do the same, and the registered audit control test passed.
The new UPDATE is a fixed SQL string with the payee id bound as a parameter. tests/controls/test_sql_control.py::test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passed on the head commit.

The change names ticket CHG-24857, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-11 before review. Its components cover payments.http, payments.routes, payments.service, and payments.store, which are every component the diff touches.
Mara Costa, a payments change approver and not author Aisha Bello, gave a code_review approval on head commit 331108bb3b367d40cad256ab59e415b266333730.
The change is a single commit, and both the code review and the security review name that same head commit.

CI on the final commit reports result failure: 172 tests, 1 failure, 0 skipped. The registered exhaustive MFA-1 test tests.controls.test_routes_control#test_privileged_routes_require_mfa failed because POST /payees/{id}/reopen lacks MFA.
The diff touches security-sensitive components payments.http, payments.routes, and payments.store. Kofi Mensah, a security reviewer and not the author, approved security_review on the head commit.

The MFA deviation is presented under EXC-0183, but that exception expired on 2026-09-13 and review time is 2026-10-16. It also covers only the reconciliation batch account, while the route drops MFA for every caller.

Acceptance record ACR-0404 covers apps/baseline-payments/payments/routes.py for MFA-1, and this change alters that file's behavior. The replacement exhaustive control test on the head commit failed, so evidence of the same strength is not available.

summary: The change adds POST /payees/{id}/reopen for privileged action manage_payees without multi-factor authentication. The cited MFA exception EXC-0183 expired before review and does not cover every caller of the route, and the exhaustive route control test failed on the head commit, so the full suite is not green. Prior ledger evidence for the route table therefore lapses without a passing replacement. The ticket, independent code review, security review, and the encryption, audit, and SQL behavior of the new path are in order, but the MFA break is enough to reject the change.
